gates.title: Every part of the BOM is in the product, as many as the BOM says
gates.detail: 62 parts from 31 of 37 BOM lines in one frame; not in it: arm (the gooseneck bends to each pose, so it is a PointMass in each (armMassG, an estimate), not a shape); psu (the supply stands on the desk or in the wall socket; only its cable reaches the product); diode (on the junction board, inside the board's 4.5 mm parts envelope); r220 (one on the junction board (in its envelope), two in-line at the stick, three on the LED legs: in the wiring); r1k (in-line in the mic clock wires on the bonnet (assembly step 13): wiring, not modelled); harness (ribbon: 690 mm through the arm, the rest peeled into jumpers; its mass rides as PointMasses)

gates.title: No two parts are in the same place
gates.detail: 62 parts, no two share volume but the fits meant to (15)

gates.title: The parts meant to touch do
Every other pair is at least 0.2 mm apart
gates.detail: base-top is 0.15 mm from junction beside where they touch, at (34.6, 24.8, 24.5); head-upper is 0.15 mm from head-lower beside where they touch, at (-53.6, 125.7, 230.3); head-upper is 0.07 mm from mute beside where they touch, at (61.4, 109.7, 234.1); head-lower is 0.10 mm from sd; head-lower is 0.15 mm from cam beside where they touch, at (57.9, 122.0, 228.7)

gates.title: The parts meant to be inside the case are inside it
It stands, tilted 10 deg and pushed
